verdict.rationale: Aleph documents its own versioned forecasts, scenario modeling, and variance analysis (forecast vs. actuals), plus 150+ connectors that feed live data into models. That covers the generic plan-and-track-against-actuals loop. However, no evidence explicitly describes revenue planning or building a plan from CRM pipeline or subscription data. Missing for 10: explicit revenue-planning capability, documented CRM pipeline or subscription/billing data sources driving revenue models, revenue-specific plan-vs-actuals tracking, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
